subject.title: Plugin context engines cannot increment /status compaction count

question: Which plugin-facing compaction reporting contract should OpenClaw support for context engines that own compaction: an `afterTurn`/maintenance callback, a lifecycle return value, or a status/stats query surface?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the fix changes the public context-engine/plugin lifecycle contract and needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Add a lifecycle callback
options.body: Pass a narrow host callback through `afterTurn` and maintenance params so engines can increment the canonical session counter only after successful owned compactions.

options.title: Return compaction metadata
options.body: Allow `afterTurn` or maintenance to return a small result object, but this broadens existing lifecycle signatures for plugin implementations.

options.title: Query engine stats
options.body: Let status query an optional engine stats method, but reconcile carefully so it does not create a second source of truth beside session state.

recommendation.title: Add a lifecycle callback
recommendation.body: Pass a narrow host callback through `afterTurn` and maintenance params so engines can increment the canonical session counter only after successful owned compactions.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman authored the context-engine API and transcript maintenance contract that would need the new reporting shape.
